column2: Anyone with a wallet can mint or deposit.
KYC to mint/redeem with the issuer, but the token transfers freely and can be bought on-chain without KYC.
Only allowlisted/KYC'd accounts can hold or access it.
Point-in-time as of Oct 6, 2026; variable. Robinhood Earn's 7% includes promotional reward tokens; base lending yield is ~3.5–4%.
Most chain yield routes through Morpho USDG markets; ~66% of steakUSDG is lent against USDe. Markets ~90% utilized.
Robinhood runs the only sequencer; only 2 allowlisted validators can submit fraud proofs; 7-day canonical bridge withdrawals.
'Hybrid' for Stock Tokens is technical; restricted persons (US, CA, UK, CH, UAE) are legally barred from buying.
mGLO own APY, Pendle PT-USDG rate, rUSDG APY, syrup/wstETH/weETH supply, sUSDe deployment.
